name: ftl-dev
description: FreeMarker (.ftl) language support for CodeOSS — scripting-oriented tooling

ftl-dev.comparisonOperatorPresentation.description: Show alphabetic comparison operators (lt, lte, gt, gte) as <, <=, >, >= in the editor. Off by default (editor decorations can distort the minimap). Place the caret on a token to reveal the source text when enabled.

ftl-dev.strictVariables.description: Warn on undeclared root identifiers in FTL expressions (ADR 0002 layer B). Off by default — enable only when the team maintains in-file declarations and/or ftl-dev.dataModel allowlist. Does not perform Java bean / type checking.

ftl-dev.dataModel.description: Host-injected top-level FreeMarker data-model names (e.g. userService, request). Used when ftl-dev.strictVariables is enabled to silence known roots. Merged with roots from workspace-folder `.ftl-data-model.json` when present.

ftl-dev.ftldoc.validateParams.description: Report ftldoc `@param` names that do not match a parameter of the documented #function / #macro, and duplicate `@param` entries (Information severity).
